sections.title: Your scans stay under your control
sections.body: 3D Model Anything does not require an account and does not send scans, photos, room layouts, or usage analytics to the developer. The app has no advertising, tracking, or developer-operated cloud service.

sections.title: What the app saves
sections.body: Full room scanning saves geometry, reference photos, depth frames, camera poses and tracking maps on your device, with optional magnetic measurements. Saved LiDAR + magnetic survey mode omits new reference photos and depth RGB images. Live survey — don’t save creates no house, room or capture files: LiDAR tracking and the latest magnetic sample stay in memory and are cleared on stopping or leaving the foreground. All modes need the camera for tracking. Saved scans can include room names, scan times, device/system information and technical diagnostics. Photos and geometry can reveal private details.

sections.title: Permissions
sections.body: Camera access is requested when you start a scan. Motion sensor access may be requested when you enable magnetic recording. Optional live guidance requests Local Network access to connect to your chosen PC. Tap to speak requests microphone and speech recognition access; recognition is required to stay on-device, with typing as a fallback. The microphone stops when you close the guide panel or the app becomes inactive. You can manage permissions in Settings. The app does not request Contacts, location or Photos library access.

sections.title: Optional live guide
sections.body: Only when you connect to a ready PC, magnetic measurements, sensor quality, camera positions, scan status, LiDAR range summaries and submitted questions go to that PC over a paired but unencrypted LAN connection. Use a trusted private network. No photos, full mesh or raw microphone audio are sent. The PC can send questions, conversation context and measurement summaries to OpenAI through Codex using your PC login and account limits. This is a separate guide conversation. Optional speech sending submits recognized text after a short pause; disable it to review first. Speech recognition stays on-device; iOS voices read replies locally. The PC keeps its own readable snapshot, including for unsaved phone surveys. Connection, voice and speech preferences are remembered; the phone pairing code is stored in Keychain and the PC keeps a local pairing-code file. The link stops when stopped, when leaving/finishing/discarding the scan or when the app becomes inactive, and does not reconnect automatically.

sections.title: Sharing and Files
sections.body: Nothing is shared automatically. When you use Share, iOS sends the exported ZIP to the app, service, device, or person you choose. Exports may contain reference photos and other recorded scan data, including technical diagnostics in session or whole-house exports. A room mesh can include nearby surfaces recorded during the same session. Review the destination before sharing. Copies you share or save elsewhere are controlled by that destination and are not removed when you delete the original.

sections.title: Storage, backups and deletion
sections.body: Scans are stored in the app’s Documents folder, also accessible through Files. Your device backup settings may include this data in an Apple device backup. The app itself does not synchronize scans to a developer server. Rooms and individual scan versions moved to Recently Deleted remain stored until you restore them or explicitly delete them permanently. Deleting a house permanently removes its local scan data. Device backups and exported copies must be managed separately.

sections.title: Imported scans and temporary exports
sections.body: When you import a folder, the app copies its room data into local storage. The original folder remains where you selected it. Temporary ZIP files are used to prepare shares and are removed after the share sheet closes; abandoned temporary shares are cleaned up later.

sections.title: Changes and support
sections.body: This policy describes this version of 3D Model Anything. Updates will include a revised policy if the app’s data practices change. Support contact information is provided on the app’s App Store support page once published.
